description: Is this IP address a known threat: botnet C2 (Feodo Tracker), hijacked / criminal netblocks (Spamhaus DROP), active attackers (CINS), Tor exit nodes, URLhaus hosts, plus the allocation (network, organisation, country from RDAP) and the country against the FATF, EU, FinCEN 311 and OFAC lists. Returns allow / review / block with reasons. Use for login and session risk, instruction-change requests, API callers and SOC triage.
